notes: Predictor #2. Scalar pedestrian walking/evasion speed.

notes: Predictor #3. Scalar tramming speed of LHD/Scoop derived from tool RPM.

generation_method: Scalar sum: worker_speed + machine_speed
notes: Predictor #4. Simplified scalar closing speed proxy; not a signed vector closing velocity.

generation_method: Discrete uniform sampling in {0, 1, 2, 3}
notes: Predictor #5. Categorical pedestrian heading code (0: North, 1: East, 2: South, 3: West).

generation_method: Discrete uniform sampling in {0, 1, 2, 3}
notes: Predictor #6. Categorical machinery heading code (0: North, 1: East, 2: South, 3: West).

generation_method: Deterministic formula: distance_3d / max(relative_speed, 0.1)
notes: Predictor #7. Scalar time-to-collision proxy; dominant variable in TTC baseline rules and synthetic target.

generation_method: Binary rule: distance_3d < 5.0 m and aligned heading
notes: Predictor #8. Binary exclusion zone flag; directly triggers deterministic TTC baseline.

generation_method: Discrete multinomial sampling (0: Idle, 1: Hauling, 2: Mucking)
notes: Predictor #9. Operating cycle state of LHD ScoopTram.

generation_method: Gaussian sampling: N(75, 12) + speed/proximity elevation
notes: Predictor #10. Pedestrian heart rate telemetry; modulates synthetic score when bpm > 60.

generation_method: Beta distribution Beta(2, 5) modulated by tool operating hours
notes: Predictor #11. Psychophysiological fatigue index; weighted by 1.8 in target score.

generation_method: Log-normal sampling modulated by torque_nm and failure_flag
notes: Predictor #12. Machine mechanical vibration severity; used in decoupled vibration target.

generation_method: Normal sampling: N(9.81, 0.5) with transient shock spikes
notes: Predictor #13. Vertical chassis inertial acceleration sensor.

generation_method: Mixture model: background N(8, 3) + exponential hazard spikes [0, 120]
notes: Predictor #14. Carbon monoxide concentration; weighted by (gas_co_ppm / 40.0) in score.

generation_method: Gamma distribution Gamma(k=2, theta=1.5) bounded in [0.1, 20.0]
notes: Predictor #15. Respirable airborne dust density; weighted by (dust_density / 5.0) * 0.6 in score.

generation_method: Truncated normal: N(45, 20) bounded in [5.0, 150.0]
notes: Predictor #16. Gallery illuminance; inverse weighting (-ambient_light / 120.0 * 0.5) in score.

generation_method: Percentile cutoffs (45th and 78th percentiles) on S = S_spatial + S_multimodal + noise
notes: Supervised classification target; distribution: 4500 LOW (45%), 3300 MEDIUM (33%), 2200 HIGH (22%).
